subject.title: Flaky tests on Windows/WSL: timeouts and ENOENT in pi-tools workspace-paths & safe-bins

question: Should maintainers require fresh WSL/Testbox reproduction before queueing another narrow repair for the renamed agent-tools workspace-paths and safe-bins tests?
rationale: The source still matches the reported failure shape, but the issue carries no-new-fix-pr, needs-maintainer-review, needs-live-repro, and an open partial closing PR, so automation should pause for proof and ownership intent.

options.title: Require Fresh WSL Proof First
options.body: Keep this issue open and require a WSL/Testbox run or explicit maintainer confirmation before queueing another repair.

options.title: Allow Source-Backed Repair Now
options.body: Queue a narrow test-only repair using the shared temp helpers and existing WSL detection without waiting for live reproduction.

options.title: Keep Fs-Safe PR Separate
options.body: Let https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/90273 proceed or close independently without using it to resolve this issue.

recommendation.title: Require Fresh WSL Proof First
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and require a WSL/Testbox run or explicit maintainer confirmation before queueing another repair.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest current and prior history on the affected test surface and authored the previous narrow-fix review guidance.
